title: End-of-Volume Statement Added to Line 25

illustrates.quote: When the text ends on the last line of a page, the end-of-volume statement may be included on the line if it is preceded and followed by three blank cells.

blocks.features: No print excerpt is given in the source for this example -- only a boxed braille-only excerpt is shown, illustrating braille page-layout mechanics (where the end-of-volume/end-of-book statement falls), confirmed against the PDF page image.

braille.notes: Braille page lines 23-25, verbatim. Text ('cells8') runs to the very end of line 25; the end-of-volume statement is appended on that same line, separated from the preceding text by three blank cells and from the trailing braille page number by a further run of blank cells.

uncertain: The braille page number '#,-' is preserved verbatim; not decoded to a specific value (see example-1-4).
resolution: Both runs agree on the braille content verbatim and that no print excerpt is given. Emboss has no end-of-volume/end-of-book statement feature at all (standards-findings.md F-54: no code path generates 'End of Volume __.'/'The End.' anywhere) -- there is also no real print content to build from. status: not-representable (limitation: no print given, and F-54).
